answers.genPolicy:df0871034bf3d1fd055c65522c54ab:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'leave' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < cloudA | 'cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | (Device ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ cloudA 'sendCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'share' ; UserY) .
[B4] < cloudA | 'cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | (Device ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ cloudA 'sendCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'revoke' ; UserY) .
[B5] < RelayUser | ... > < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; L)
=> < RelayUser | ... > < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L) .
[B6] < CachingRelayUser | 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' CachingRelayUser | (Device ; L)
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'cachedCommand' : L , ... > .
[B7] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... >
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L) .
[B8] < Device | 'trusted' : Trusted , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'share' ; UserY)
=> < Device | 'trusted' : (Trusted , UserY) , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ... > .
[B9] < Device | 'trusted' : (Trusted , UserY) , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'revoke' ; UserY)
=> < Device | 'trusted' : Trusted , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ... > .
